data.one_liner: Catch screenshots and screen recordings on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: Detects when users take a screenshot or record the screen in your application using system callbacks and directory observation. It also allows developers to prevent Android screenshots and recordings.
use_when: You need to detect screenshots for security or analytics purposes.
You want to block screen capturing and recording on Android for sensitive screens.
avoid_when: You need detailed file paths for screenshots on iOS (which are not exposed by the platform).
You do not want to request broader storage or media permissions on older Android versions.
strengths: Supports modern Android system callbacks on Android 14 and 15 without prompt.
Can prevent screenshots and recordings on Android.
weaknesses: Android screen recording detection on older versions relies on specific folder watchers and best-effort mechanisms.
iOS does not expose the screenshot file path or prevent screenshots natively through this package.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding permissions to AndroidManifest.xml for older Android versions or media paths if file paths are needed.
